title: Outdoor Cleaning Arm | Alai Labs
description: A robotic arm fitted to trucks, with LIDAR and AI cameras, for public cleaning and structural maintenance.

head.p_1: A robotic arm fitted to trucks, with LIDAR and AI cameras, for public cleaning and structural maintenance.

img_1.alt: Alai Outdoor Cleaning Arm: a robotic arm mounted on a truck, cleaning a drain at the roadside

about.caption_1: Existing image. Photos and a video of the product at work are to come; the video will play only when you press play.
about.p_1: The Outdoor Cleaning Arm retrofits a robotic arm onto a truck. LIDAR and AI cameras let it find and reach what needs cleaning, for public cleaning crews and for maintenance of structures along the road.
